Granted by @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.IlsT2gN1bwoO8WDD]{Lightning Dance}

You grant yourself a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.

While you are in your stance, your aspects confer an additional benefit if a creature attempts an attack against you. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.8ad23sFdfBpqwklz]{Aspect of Skies} you can choose retaliate with a shock of lightning, dealing @Damage[(max(floor(@actor.level/2),1))[electricity]] damage equal to half your level. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.pid3Nv3o23ilx3n6]{Aspect of Tides}, you can choose to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step} after the attack as water carries you away from harm. After using this benefit, you cease dancing.
